name: Dimethyl succinate
description: Dimethyl succinate (CAS 106-65-0 ), also known by FEMA 2396 , is a diester solvent and flavoring agent used across personal care formulation and food manufacturing. It functions as a carrier solvent and humectant. In food and beverage manufacturing, dimethyl succinate delivers a mild fruity, wine-like flavor note. It is used in flavoring systems for confectionery, baked goods, and beverages under regulatory approval. Personal care formulators use it as a low-viscosity carrier solvent to improve spreadability and skin feel in emollients and lotions. Its humectant behavior supports moisture retention in leave-on cosmetic formulations. This material is a practical alternative to heavier ester solvents in fragrance delivery systems. It also functions as a co-solvent in fragrance concentrates, helping to solubilize aromatic ingredients at controlled dilution. Dimethyl succinate is supplied as a clear liquid in drum and IBC quantities suited to both industrial and specialty formulation volumes. This ensures reliable logistics for large-scale manufacturing needs. Food-grade material conforming to established standards is the primary commercial specification for flavor and cosmetic applications. Technical-grade material is available for solvent and process applications. Whether used for its aromatic properties or its solvent capabilities, this diester provides consistent performance. It remains a versatile component for chemists developing modern consumer and industrial products. Contact us for supply of Dimethyl succinate Request Quote
